```{python}

from IPython.display import Markdown

from owlroost.catalog.context import build_catalog_context
from owlroost.display.loaders import load_case_rows, load_run_rows
from owlroost.display.materializers.compare import materialize_compare_table
from owlroost.display.materializers.materialize import materialize_view
from owlroost.display.renderers.markdown_table import render_markdown_table
from owlroost.display.operations.table_ops import inject_id_column

from owlroost.workspace.loaders import (
    load_workspace_row,
)

# =====================================================
# Catalog
# =====================================================

catalog = build_catalog_context()

workspace_row = load_workspace_row( "." )

CASE_FOLDER = workspace_row.get("cases_dir",".")

```

## Cases Listing

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# this gets replaced with study.list_cases( view )  # what engine?

rows = load_case_rows(
        CASE_FOLDER,
        schema_registry=catalog.schema_registry,
        metrics_registry=catalog.metrics_registry
    )

if rows:

    pivot = False
    level = "case"
    view = "cases"
    explain_facets = None

    table = materialize_view(
        rows=rows,
        registry=catalog.display_registry,
        catalog_index=catalog.catalog_index,
        level=level,
        view_name=view,
        mode="pivot" if pivot else "table",
        explain_facets=explain_facets,
    )

    print("Below is a list of cases found in this workspace.\n\n")

    output = render_markdown_table( table )
    print(output)

else:
    print("""
No case files were found in this workspace.  Run OWL and save the resulting
TOML to this folder.
""")
```

## Results listing

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# this gets replaced with study.list_runs( view )

rows = load_run_rows( metrics_registry=catalog.metrics_registry,results_root="results" )

if rows:
    pivot = False
    level = "run"
    view = "results"
    explain_facets = None

    table = materialize_view(
        rows=rows,
        registry=catalog.display_registry,
        catalog_index=catalog.catalog_index,
        level=level,
        view_name=view,
        mode="pivot" if pivot else "table",
        explain_facets=explain_facets,
    )

    print("Below is a list of run results found in this workspace.")
    output = render_markdown_table( table )
    print("\n\n"+output)
else:
    print("""
No results were found in this workspace.  Run "roost build" to create results.
""")
```
